Backend Developer (Python)

About us
Northwind Ledger is a fast-growing fintech company in Stockholm. We help 4 000 small businesses get paid on time. Our team of 60 people comes from 20 countries.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and maintain the REST APIs behind our invoicing platform
- Write well-tested Python services and review your colleagues' code
- Improve the performance and reliability of our PostgreSQL databases
- Take part in the on-call rotation and fix production incidents

Requirements
- At least three years of experience developing backend systems in Python
- Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
- Experience with Docker and cloud platforms such as AWS
- Fluent English; Swedish is a plus

What we offer
- Hybrid work with three office days a week
- Six weeks of vacation and a wellness allowance of 5 000 SEK
- Occupational pension and private health insurance
